user.title: Router
user.description: The MikroTik that hands out the miners' addresses. Prefilled with Home Assistant's own gateway. Fastest: reuse the Site Health login; otherwise generate a block to paste into the router terminal. No scripts are installed on the router: the integration adds its block rule itself and pins miners' addresses with static DHCP leases.

asic.title: Miner web credentials
asic.description: Digest-auth credentials for the miners' web UI. Antminer defaults are root / root.

onboard.title: Paste into the router terminal
onboard.description:
Open a terminal on **{host}** and paste. It enables HTTPS for Home Assistant **{ha_ip}** only and creates the user `ha-asic` (read + write: address lists, firewall, leases) with a random password. Then press Submit.

```
{script}
```

data.hostname_pattern: Name pattern (regex): rack R1-ASIC3 or place Garazh-ASIC2; groups rack/place and index
data.probe_unknown: Probe unknown DHCP leases for miners
data.fail_threshold: Consecutive polls before raising a problem
data.probe_subnets: Miner subnets to probe (comma separated; empty = the router's ASIC segment: an *asic* interface or VLAN 64)
data.pin_ips: Pin miners' addresses (static DHCP leases) — keeps blocks valid without a router script
data.auto_configure: Add the block rule on the router automatically

data_description.probe_unknown: Finds miners that never publish a DHCP hostname (e.g. Antminer L9) by asking each unknown lease whether it answers the miner CGI API.
data_description.fail_threshold: Guards against single-poll blips raising false alarms.
data_description.allow_pool_write: set_miner_conf.cgi replaces the miner's whole config. Leave off unless you need it.

block.name: Block internet
block.description: Cut the miner's WAN access at the router.

reboot.name: Reboot
reboot.description: Reboot the miner via its web API.

on.name: On
on.description: Turn the LED on or off.

block_rack.name: Block rack
block_rack.description: Cut WAN access for every miner in a rack.

unblock_rack.name: Unblock rack
unblock_rack.description: Restore WAN access for every miner in a rack.

reboot_rack.name: Reboot rack
reboot_rack.description: Reboot every miner in a rack, optionally spaced out in time.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.description: Seconds to wait between miners so the load ramps instead of stepping.

assign_name.name: Assign name
assign_name.description: Give a permanent name to a miner that reports no DHCP hostname, keyed by MAC.

set_pools.name: Set pools
set_pools.description: Rewrite the miner's pool list. Requires the pool-write option to be enabled.

pools.name: Pools
pools.description: List of up to three pools, each with url, user and pass.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Poll the router and every miner immediately.

discover.name: Find miners
discover.description: Re-scan the network now, including leases previously judged uninteresting.

add_device.name: Add miner
add_device.description: Add a miner by hand, for a machine discovery cannot reach.

ip.name: IP
ip.description: Static address, if it has one.

forget_device.name: Forget miner
forget_device.description: Remove a miner from the inventory and delete its device.

mac.name: MAC
mac.description: MAC address, if you are not targeting a device.

reset.name: Reset inventory
reset.description: Forget every discovered miner and start discovery over.

keep_manual.name: Keep hand-added
keep_manual.description: Hand-added miners cannot be rediscovered, so they are kept by default.
